structure: New Hampshire K-12 Social Studies Curriculum Framework (June 2006). Front matter (cover, credits, TOC, Introduction, goals) pp.1-6; Part 1 'Ten Themes' (Themes A-J with definition, examples, essential questions) plus Themes/Strands and Themes/Social Science grids (landscape pages, extracted as table cells plus rotated duplicate text fragments) pp.7-12; Part 2 Essential Skills (Skills 2.1-2.3, expectations A-K, K-12) pp.13-15; Part 3 content strands as grade-span tables: pp.16-43 Grades K-2 | 3-4 (running header 'Social Studies K-4'), pp.44-76 Grades 5-6 | 7-8 ('Social Studies 5-8'), pp.77-101 Grades 9-12 ('Social Studies 9-12'); References pp.102-103; Contributors pp.104-106. Each strand page is a table: R1 strand/standard title (e.g. 'Civics and Governments (CV:1)'), R2 strand statement of purpose, header row 'Standard | Grades K-2 | Grades 3-4', then a row with the standard statement (C1, e.g. 'SS:CV:1: The Nature and Purpose of Government ...') and the grade-span expectations in C2/C3. Codes SS:<strand>:<end grade of span>:<standard>.<expectation> (e.g. SS:CV:2:1.1 = K-2, SS:CV:4 = 3-4, 6 = 5-6, 8 = 7-8, 12 = 9-12); each expectation ends with '(Themes: ...)' tags and often an 'e.g.' example inside the same unit. Strands: Civics and Government CV:1-4, Economics EC:1-6, Geography GE:1-5, US/NH History HI:1-5, World History WH:1-5. Not course-based. The standard statement (C1) applies to every span column on that page. Many pages also carry x-positioned text fragments that are rotated/duplicate copies of the strand title, purpose statement, standard statement and cell text.

issues: Landscape-page extraction: every strand page (pp.16-101) has x-positioned fragment units (u with '(x=..)') that are broken-line duplicates of the strand title, purpose paragraph, standard statement and expectation cells already present as table cells (also pages 10-12 grids). They were labeled backup with the page's span so the verbatim text is not double-counted as standards; the full table-cell versions are labeled standards.
Pages 26, 28, 53, 58, 61, 63, 67, 70, 73, 75 contain only duplicate fragments (the table for that strand is on the next page); labeled backup with the span.
Strand statement-of-purpose paragraphs (table R2 C1, e.g. u656, u791, u1051, u1181) labeled examples as overview narrative; they could arguably be backup.

Ten Themes (u124-u205) and the theme grids (u206-u625) labeled examples (framework states themes 'are not to be understood as required standards'); grade 'all' (K-12). Grid pages 10-12 are heavily scrambled by extraction (cells plus rotated fragments); fragment units there are also examples.
Essential Skills (u629-u651) labeled standards K-12; the document says skills are not assigned to grades (local committees decide) and u629 mixes the Part 2 intro with Skill 2.1 expectations A-B.
Some source grade-span cells are blank (K-2 for SS:EC:3, SS:WH:2, SS:WH:4; 5-6 for SS:EC:4, SS:EC:5, SS:EC:6) - empty in the document, not an extraction loss.

u1544: 7-8 cell SS:EC:8:4.2 is truncated in the source (ends '...D: Material Wants and Needs' with no closing). Source typos left as is: 'A0: Human Expression' (u2402, u2477, u2568, u2606) and '1: Conflict and Cooperation' (u662).

Guide note says Intro codes ending 2/4/6/8/12 map to K-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, 9-12; verified against column headers on every page. Shared per-page units (strand title, standard statement, 'Standard' header, strand narrative) are labeled with the whole page span (K-4, 5-8, 9-12), which is not one of the guide's row clusters; the assembler should copy them into the clusters they overlap (K-2 and 3-4; 5-6 and 7-8).
Page 16 title cell u655 reads 'Strand: Civics and Governments (CV:1)'; later pages omit 'Strand:'.

Shared per-page units (strand title, purpose, standard statement, 'Standard' header) carry the page span (K-4, 5-8, 9-12), which is not one of the guide's row clusters; assembler should copy into overlapping clusters (K-2 and 3-4; 5-6 and 7-8).
